def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if sep is None:
        return out
    top = grid[0]
    bottom = grid[-1]
    overlap = {c for c, v in enumerate(top) if v != 0 and c < len(bottom) and bottom[c] == v}
    for r in range(1, sep):
        for c in overlap:
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
PY
